scenario.name: CISA/NSA/FBI Telecom Guidance, GSMA FS.31 & ENISA 5G — 5G Core Service-Based Interface (SBI) NRF/UDM & Diameter Roaming Audit
scenario.overview: Imagine a modern city transit control center where every department exchanges digital work orders across a high-speed glass hallway using short-lived badge passes issued by a central registry booth. An intruder on an unauthorized maintenance terminal walks up to the registry booth to mint a high-clearance pass, walks straight to the passenger-tracking desk to pull real-time cell tower locations, and simultaneously sends spoofed cross-border roaming inquiries at the outer border gate where signaling guards flag the impossible travel speed. In this scenario (T1528, CISA/NSA/FBI Telecom Guidance, GSMA FS.31 & ENISA 5G - 5G Core Service-Based Interface , SBI NRF/UDM & Diameter Roaming Audit), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: 5G NRF NFRegister, then uDM Subscriber Data, then diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering 5G NRF NFRegister, then UDM Subscriber Data, then Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on Suricata Event 200 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 2: UDM Subscriber Data & Serving AMF/gNodeB Location Query (/nudm-sdm/v2/)
stages.subtitle: Collection (T1557 - Adversary-in-the-Middle)
stages.description: Flashing that freshly stamped hallway pass at the passenger-tracking desk, the intruder queries permanent subscriber identities and reads back the exact neighborhood station and tower currently serving each targeted commuter. On the diagram, follow Step #2 / Link #2 (#2→ GET /nudm-uecm/v1/imsi-310260991827364/registrations/amf-3gpp-access HTTP/2 / ⇠#2 ACK 200) from Node ② (#2 Perimeter Firewall & NDR Tap) to Node ③ (#3 5G Security Edge Proxy (SEPP)), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 UDR Subscriber & LI Database).

keySpecs.value: Implement GSMA FS.37 / 3GPP TS 33.501 authorization policies on UDM/UDR so only registered, IP-allowlisted AMF and SMF instances can query subscriber location or authentication vectors.

stages.title: Stage 3: Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data (IDR) & SEPP Interconnect Anomaly Correlation
stages.subtitle: Discovery (T1046 - Network Service Discovery)
stages.description: Meanwhile, at the international roaming checkpoint linking older and newer transit lines, signaling guards inspect cross-border authentication slips whose sender seal does not match the physical transport lane and drop the forged frames while linking them back to the internal tracking query. In parallel across the 4G/5G interworking boundary, signaling firewalls inspect Diameter S6a Authentication-Information-Request (AIR, Command Code 318) and Insert-Subscriber-Data-Request (IDR, Command Code 319) frames arriving from external PLMN roaming peers with mismatched Origin-Host and source SCTP/IP bindings (logged in Suricata IDS Event 318 with SignalingProtocol=Diameter S6a , 3GPP TS 29.272 Command Code 318 AIR, FirewallRuleTriggered=GSMA FS.19 Category 2 Velocity & Home-Network Location Mismatch, DefensiveAction=Signaling frame dropped at DEA / SEPP and correlated with SBI UDM query so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). On the diagram, follow Step #3 / Link #3 (#3→ Diameter S6a cmd=318 (AIR) Origin-Realm=epc.mnc099.mcc250.3gppnetwork.org velocity_anomaly=true / ⇠#3 ALERT 318) from Node ③ (#3 5G Security Edge Proxy (SEPP)) to Node ④ (#4 5G Core NRF & UDM (HTTP/2 SBI)), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 UDR Subscriber & LI Database).

steps.plainTitle: Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data (IDR) & SEPP Interconnect Anomaly Correlation
steps.storyAnalogy: Meanwhile, at the international roaming checkpoint linking older and newer transit lines, signaling guards inspect cross-border authentication slips whose sender seal does not match the physical transport lane and drop the forged frames while linking them back to the internal tracking query.
steps.simpleExplanation: In parallel across the 4G/5G interworking boundary, signaling firewalls inspect Diameter S6a Authentication-Information-Request (AIR, Command Code 318) and Insert-Subscriber-Data-Request (IDR, Command Code 319) frames arriving from external PLMN roaming peers with mismatched Origin-Host and source SCTP/IP bindings (logged in Suricata IDS Event 318 with SignalingProtocol=Diameter S6a , 3GPP TS 29.272 Command Code 318 AIR, FirewallRuleTriggered=GSMA FS.19 Category 2 Velocity & Home-Network Location Mismatch, DefensiveAction=Signaling frame dropped at DEA / SEPP and correlated with SBI UDM query so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact).
steps.howItWorksInPractice: Under the hood, the observed step executes tshark -r diameter_s6a_interconnect.pcap -Y "diameter.cmd.code == 318 || diameter.cmd.code == 319" -T fields -e sctp.srcport -e diameter.Origin-Host -e diameter.Origin-Realm -e diameter.User-Name (which executes the technical command / telemetry directive , tshark -r diameter_s6a_interconnect.pcap -Y "diameter.cmd.code == 318 || diameter.cmd.code = so that advances the scenario kill-chain under MITRE T1046 during "Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data , IDR & SEPP Interconnect Anomaly Correlation" , In parallel across the 4G/5G interworking boundary, signaling firewalls inspect Diameter S6a Authentication-Information-Request , AIR, Command Code 318 and Insert-Subscriber-Data-Request , IDR, Command Code 319 frames arriving from external PLMN roaming peers with mismatched Origin-Host and source SCTP/IP bindings while generating verifiable host or network telemetry for DFIR attribution).

steps.detectionAndEvidence: Documented in Suricata IDS Event 318 (recording SignalingProtocol=Diameter S6a , 3GPP TS 29.272 Command Code 318 AIR, FirewallRuleTriggered=GSMA FS.19 Category 2 Velocity & Home-Network Location Mismatch, DefensiveAction=Signaling frame dropped at DEA / SEPP and correlated with SBI UDM query under T1046): Enforce GSMA FS.19 Diameter Signaling Firewall Category 1–3 rules at the roaming edge: verify Origin-Host/Origin-Realm against the peer SCTP IP association and correlate subscriber location against previous attach velocity.
